close_reason: Added last_id_check: Instant to CachedStsEntry; DNS TXT check now throttled to once per 60s per domain on cache hits
description: relay_client.rs:112 — on every cache hit the enforcer still does lookup_mta_sts_txt() to check for policy id rotation (RFC 8461 §4.1 SHOULD). This means every outbound delivery to a cached domain performs a DNS round trip. For a busy server sending to a handful of domains, this adds one DNS RTT per delivery. RFC 8461 says SHOULD (not MUST), so the id check could be batched (e.g. once per minute or per N deliveries) rather than per-message. At low send volume this is irrelevant; at high volume it adds up.
title: MtaStsEnforcer does DNS TXT lookup on every delivery even on cache hits
